transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what's been troubling you or what brings you in today?

Hi. Thank you. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I just feel like I can’t settle in my own body anymore. It’s... it's especially noticeable when I’m supposed to sit quietly and handle things, like paperwork or sitting down to go over shared household plans. I just feel this constant restlessness.
When you feel this restlessness, do you also feel a need to move around or find yourself fidgeting or pacing?

Yeah, I definitely do. Um, like in church meetings or during family dinners... I'm usually twisting my wedding ring around, or, you know, bouncing my foot. I just end up shifting around in my chair a lot, even when I'm trying really hard to just sit still and look composed.
When you feel that restlessness, do you also notice feelings of worry or anxiety coming up, or does it seem more like just a physical need to move without being overly anxious?

No, I don't really notice any worry or anxiety with it. It's definitely more just a physical need to move. Um, I'm not sitting there stressing over anything in particular... my body just feels like it needs to be doing something. So yeah, it's not really an anxious feeling, just that physical restlessness.

latest_inference.note: This turn ruled out F41.0 (generalized anxiety disorder) because the patient explicitly denied feelings of anxiety or worry accompanying the restlessness, which is more consistent with a primarily physical restlessness seen in ADHD (F90.0).
